reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for beta-alanine, or any supplement. What I can say is that it's one of the better-studied ones, mostly for efforts lasting roughly one to four minutes, and the common side effect people mention is a tingling feeling. The benefit is modest next to training, sleep and eating enough. For how much is right for you, check with a doctor or a dietitian, especially if you take any medication.

If you're chasing performance, I'd rather look at your training first. Want me to pull up how your lifts are trending?
